svg.title: MedQueue GH — system architecture
svg.desc: Five-layer architecture diagram: Flutter client apps connect to a Django REST API gateway, which routes to backend service modules. Service modules persist to PostgreSQL and Redis, and integrate with Arkesel SMS, WhatsApp API, Firebase, OpenAI, and Google Maps.
